summary: Read neural activity at event, field and population scales without collapsing them into one kind of signal.
outcomes: Interpret rasters, firing-rate estimates and multichannel field traces.
Explain how binning and averaging change the apparent pattern.
sequence: Compare a waveform, event time and raster
Estimate rate with bins and kernels
Introduce local field signals and spatial mixing
Compare trial average and single-trial structure

visual.question: Can the same spikes look smooth or bursty depending on the view?
visual.interaction: Change bin width and kernel bandwidth while preserving original event times.

practice.task: Describe a synthetic population response using two bin widths.
practice.success: Retains event-level evidence and explains the smoothing tradeoff without treating LFP as mean spike rate.
